$comment: Hand-set fields merged on top of what scripts/build-asset-index.mjs infers from file names. Keys are asset ids from data/assets.json. These brands were guessed when the index was first built (UNICEF and Digital Impact logos sit on the Logos page's Digital Inclusion tab; GEP and the Connectivity Forum are Giga events; the fonts are shared by both brands and filed under Digital Inclusion). Change any value here, then run npm run build or node scripts/build-asset-index.mjs. The boxed UNICEF Digital Impact Division file named -black is the full-colour lockup (blue box, black text), so its colour is set to full-colour here.
